info.title: Storage CLI ask authorization API
info.description: Design v1.15: the CLI generates and persists a canonical UUIDv7 auth_id as the single public resource ID and auth_sessions A primary key for create, poll, claim, refresh, credentials, status and logout. No phase aliases or separate grant row exist. Status uses required query auth_id plus BrokerBearer; logout requires JSON auth_id plus BrokerBearer. Lock A by its primary key and authenticate with its fixed stored HMAC version, without broker reverse lookup, key enumeration or a broker unique index. IDs are public locators; all tokens remain in Authorization headers or JSON bodies. R.request_id, claim_request_id, Idempotency-Key and outer trace request_id are distinct independently generated canonical RFC-variant UUIDv7 identities; ask-result request_id is also UUIDv7; Doubao question session_id is unrelated. Login and authorization deadlines remain separate, claimed is only a bounded public projection, and R retains independent bounded refresh recovery. CLI calls Doubao directly for questions. Only OAuth lifecycle endpoints are defined here; no /ask or arbitrary proxy. Server URL is configured by the released CLI after M0, not supplied per request.

post.description: Create A=auth_sessions with the CLI-generated auth_id primary key and status=pending. While the original request_hash and login ticket remain, same ID/ticket/normalized payload returns the same login resource without extending login_expires_at; changed ticket/payload returns 409 idempotency_conflict. If A still exists but its original creation group has been cleared, return 409 idempotency_conflict: never overwrite, reauthorize or reset that existing session. New login uses a new auth_id. If A is absent an insert may create a new operation, always with a fresh server state nonce; the full original-state fence rejects old callbacks after ID reuse.

get.description: Lookup A by the auth_id primary key; authenticate the retained login ticket before any public LoginState projection. exchanging maps to pending; active/refreshing may map to claimed only while claim metadata/cache and login deadline remain valid. Poll does not require claim_verifier. If A is active/refreshing and the retained login deadline has elapsed, authenticated polling returns 200 with public state=expired and reason_code=claim_recovery_expired; this does not change A.status or end its authorization. Cleared login temporary authentication fields, absent A and invalid ticket all return 401 authentication_required, including when an active authorization row still exists. Retained login terminal states may be returned after ticket verification. Poll never recreates A or extends login/auth deadlines.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist before send; reuse with identical body and identity. Never reuse for a new operation.

post.description: Lock A by auth_id; authenticate retained ticket and claim_verifier before exposing any login result. Cleared login temporary fields, absent A or invalid proof return 401 authentication_required even if an active A still exists. pending/exchanging returns 409 login_pending; authenticated denied returns 403 login_denied; retained first-claim expiry returns 410 login_expired. First claim atomically changes ready to active, records claim_request_id and changes login_expires_at to at most claim+5 minutes and necessary actual credential deadlines; auth_expires_at stays separate. Replay requires active, generation=1, matching original claim ID/ticket/proof, unexpired encrypted result/login deadline, current admission and actual token validity. For active/refreshing, an elapsed retained login cache deadline returns 409 claim_recovery_expired after proof validation, before testing refresh-in-progress. Only refreshing with an unexpired retained cache returns 409 refresh_in_progress, without a cached bundle. After temporary fields are cleared use 401. Never exchange a code here.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist before send; reuse with identical body and identity. Never reuse for a new operation.

post.description: HTTP auth_id selects A by primary key; R primary key is (auth_id,request_id). Always lock A before R; do not hold a database transaction over upstream HTTP. Existing R may authenticate an exact retry with its own fixed request HMAC version; cached expiry or generation mismatch returns 409 only after proof is valid. On R miss require current A broker/RT/generation and active authorization before upstream use; ready and absent/invalid credentials return 401 authentication_required. An authenticated generation mismatch returns 409 credential_generation_mismatch. New R.pending and A.refreshing commit together; success updates A digests/generation and active with R.completed and its bounded encrypted response in one transaction. That same success clears all original login temporary/creation fields before rotating the shared A HMAC key version; R keeps its fixed independent HMAC version. Login cleanup alone never deletes active/refreshing A or changes auth_expires_at. Detected ambiguous outcomes settle R.unknown/A.reauth_required under original guards; lease sweeps settle abandoned workers. Never replay an unknown operation or infer historical success after purge.

parameters.name: auth_id
parameters.description: Public resource locator, not a secret. BrokerBearer authenticates this selected row.

get.description: Require auth_id query parameter plus BrokerBearer. Lock A by this primary key, validate app/shape and calculate the broker HMAC with this row's fixed HMAC version. Compare in constant time; never reverse-lookup broker digests or enumerate keys. Wrong or absent row, mismatching token and ready/pending/exchanging all return the same generic 401 authentication_required without revealing identity or existence. Missing/malformed auth_id, duplicate auth_id or unsupported query fields are 400 invalid_request. Return only the existing authorization-state enum, trusted identity, admission and bounded broker lifetime; no raw credentials. Cleared login temporary fields do not invalidate current broker authorization for active/refreshing and retained ended authorization phases.

post.description: Require JSON {auth_id} plus BrokerBearer. Lock A by its primary key, validate app/shape and authenticate the token using that row's fixed HMAC version with constant-time comparison. Do not reverse-lookup broker digests or enumerate keys. Wrong/absent ID, mismatching token and ready/unclaimed phases all return generic 401 authentication_required. Missing/malformed auth_id is 400 invalid_request. Revoke the authenticated authorization, end pending R and clear cached credentials atomically; remove A only after child cleanup. The same verifiable revoked current broker and auth_id may repeat logout during retained lifetime, including after admission removal. Rotated old brokers cannot authenticate current A or another A.

get.description: Server HTTPS callback. Decode OAuthState for an untrusted auth_id locator; lock that original A row, verify the full state HMAC, app, pending status and original login_expires_at before CAS to exchanging. Completion remains fenced by the original state/HMAC version/deadline. Exactly one of code and error must exist; reject duplicate state parameters. Only code exchanges a token; error does not. Success performs UPDATE on the original auth_sessions A: set trusted identity, current broker/RT digests, generation=1, encrypted first bundle, auth_expires_at and ready; clear OAuth context. There is no new authorization-row INSERT. No browser-to-CLI token redirect. No-store and no-referrer headers required.

503.description: Safe HTML completion page; no tokens or reflected raw input

Nonce.description: Canonical unpadded Base64URL of exactly 32 bytes. Decode and re-encode identically; reject nonzero unused pad bits. Used for ticket, claim proof/challenge and broker.

OAuthState.description: Unpadded Base64URL of 16 RFC-order UUIDv7 auth_id bytes followed by 32 server-random nonce bytes. Decode for primary-key lookup only; verify the complete state HMAC and original operation before exchange. Reject duplicate parameters, noncanonical encoding and wrong UUID version/variant.

LoginState.description: Public login-state projection, not a second persisted status. A pending/exchanging maps to pending, ready to ready, and authenticated login terminal states to their public names. claimed may project active/refreshing only while the retained login ticket, claim metadata/cache and login deadline remain verifiable. After an active/refreshing login deadline elapses but its ticket group remains, project expired with reason_code=claim_recovery_expired; do not change the authorization status. Polling verifies the ticket; it does not require a claim_verifier. No persisted claimed state exists. Cleared login authentication fields produce 401 instead of a projection.

auth_id.description: CLI-generated UUIDv7 and auth_sessions primary key. Persist before create; reuse only for an identical creation retry. A new login generates a new auth_id. This public locator is not a secret or an authentication credential.
The same CLI-generated auth_id supplied on creation; it identifies the same auth_sessions row through login, claim, refresh and termination.

authorization_url.description: Fixed-provider browser authorization link while pending; null after callback consumption or terminal state. No tokens, Secret or claim verifier; needed state/challenge remain intact.

expires_at.description: Short login phase deadline: original authorization/first-claim deadline, or the bounded claim replay deadline after activation. It is not auth_expires_at. Polling and retries do not extend it.

TokenBundle.description: Credential bundle carries the same unified auth_id as creation. Access/refresh token expirations live in this bundle and bounded encrypted caches; auth_expires_at is the database authorization/broker upper bound. No raw tokens are stored long term and no duplicate per-token expiry columns are required.

StatusResponse.description: Only already claimed authorization states are public here. ready is not broker-authenticated; pending/exchanging/ready are not added to this existing v1 status enum.
